description: A v1.80.2 local review that opened only the first 60 lines of severity.md from the required policy set, then rendered CHANGES REQUIRED. Skill-touching calls only, with the skill directory replaced by $SKILL_DIR; the report is reduced to its labels.

input.command: cd $SKILL_DIR && wc -c runbooks/local-review.md policies/*.md shared/policies/*.md | tail -40; cat runbooks/local-review.md
cd $SKILL_DIR && cat runbooks/local-review.md | head -250; cat templates/local-review-report.md
cd $SKILL_DIR && cat templates/local-review-report.md | head -120; sed -n 1,60p shared/policies/severity.md
